items.title: US stocks today: Dow Jones crashes 500 pts, Nasdaq over 2.5% as AI cash burn fears spark tech selloff
items.summary: US stocks tumbled on Friday as disappointing results from Intel and Amazon reignited concerns over rising artificial intelligence spending and uncertain returns. The Nasdaq recorded its biggest single-day percentage decline since June 5. Technology stocks led losses, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq also ended October in negative territory.

items.title: Reddit stock plunges 30% as Google's AI search threatens traffic and user growth
items.summary: Reddit shares plunged 23% after the company warned that Google's AI powered search features were hurting referral traffic and could lead to a decline in daily active users. Pinterest also fell after issuing a weaker revenue outlook, as pressure on European cross border sellers weighed on its business and growth expectations.

items.title: Fiscal deficit in H1 rises to 42.1% of FY27 target on higher capex, subsidies
items.summary: By September 2026, the Centre's fiscal deficit had escalated to ₹7.14 lakh crore, exceeding last year's figures. This increase is fueled by a 10.7% rise in total expenditure, largely a result of heightened capital spending and food subsidies, while petroleum subsidies sharply declined. Gross tax revenue, however, saw a modest growth of 6.1%, even with lower excise duty collections attributed to tax reforms.

items.title: Nandini milk price hike: Why Karnataka raised rates by ₹8 per litre from November 1, how rates compare with other states
items.summary: Karnataka has hiked Nandini milk prices by ₹8 per litre from November 1, with ₹7 going to farmers and ₹1 to milk unions. Despite the increase, Nandini Shubham at ₹60 per litre remains cheaper than comparable milk varieties in most states, the government’s price comparison shows.

items.title: Uttarakhand helicopter crash: What is Trans Bharat Aviation? Company named in incident with ₹58 crore revenue in FY25

CDSL has been directed to pay the penalty within 45 days, failing which recovery…

items.title: Binance hit by record $6.3 bn crypto theft; North Korea suspected
items.summary: Binance halted withdrawals after hackers stole $6.3 billion in a record crypto heist, with analysts suspecting North Korea. The exchange said it would cover losses as cryptocurrency prices fell.

items.title: Intel stock plunges 30% as weak PC demand and AI costs trigger global chip selloff
items.summary: Intel shares plunged 30% after the chipmaker issued a weak fourth-quarter revenue forecast and warned of negative cash flow for the year. The warning triggered a global semiconductor selloff, with Nvidia, AMD and other chip stocks declining as weak PC demand and rising AI infrastructure costs weighed on sentiment.

items.title: Extreme poverty in India falls to 2.6% from 27.1%: World Bank
items.summary: As many as 496 million people moved above the lower-middle-income poverty line of $4.20 a day between 2011 and 2023, according to the World Bank’s October 2026 Poverty & Equity Brief.

items.title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit falls 36% as litigation costs hit earnings
items.summary: Sun Pharma reported a 36% decline in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 1,989 crore due to exceptional litigation and acquisition-related costs. Revenue grew 11.8%, supported by strong domestic and emerging market sales, while US formulations weakened.
